item.title: metabase: 0.59.2 -> 0.63.5
item.description:
Replaces https://github.com/NixOS/nixpkgs/pull/502079 which suffers from multiple critical security vulnerabilities:

  • https://www.metabase.com/blog/security-update-6-aug-2026

Changelogs:

  • https://www.metabase.com/changelog/59
  • https://www.metabase.com/changelog/60
  • https://www.metabase.com/changelog/61
  • https://www.metabase.com/changelog/62
  • https://www.metabase.com/changelog/63

There are a couple of "small" breaking changes, the legacy Druid driver is deprecated in 0.62, and the sample database format was changed from h2 to sqlite in 0.63.

Please merge #551107 before this PR, as the tests in this one will fail without the additional memory.

item.description:

Some of these should be dropped on unstable as well as the upstreams are dead (bookshelf primarily).

item.title: rsync: 3.4.4 -> 3.5.0
item.description:
Updates rsync and rrsync to 3.5.0, fixing 33 vulnerabilities found by upstream audits of path handling and the daemon protocol.

Five of these CVEs are rated Critical by their CNAs.
